summary: Recovered the authoritative Alumnos/student-facing surface without rebuilding it. PROJECT_INDEX still has no primary Alumnos binding and points to three child lineages. R06 Student World recovery is integrated/closed; R07 PageKit recovery is complete and capability-only; Jose study V11 is the newest durable lab frontier but explicitly not Current/Served. CURRENT_GRAPH page currents resolve Alumnos/Jose through Catalog. Catalog live entries include Student World Jose -> pages/PROMETEO_STUDENT_WORLD_MAP_FIXED_OPEN_ME.html, Jose Study -> https://juanmanuelpm.github.io/jose-study/, Jose Algebra -> pages/JOSE_RECUPERACION_ALGEBRA_FINAL.html, plus Jose chemistry/atlas/index-laws/homework. The currently cataloged Student World bytes on gh-pages identify themselves as a D2 Atlas five-level proof/demo, creating a grounded gap between the live entry and the richer unserved Jose-study frontier. The active universal-swarm Alumnos campaign targets alumnos-teacher, so the proposed successor is student-facing and deduplicated from that campaign.

unresolved: Public HTTP response propagation for each route was not independently measured in this run; source bytes on serving branches/repos were verified instead.
No promotion decision is implied for Jose V11 or any reconstructed surface.
